name: agendamea
description: Günlük görevlerinizi zahmetsizce planlayın. İnternetsiz çalışan, her değişikliği anında kaydeden sade ve hızlı Windows görev yöneticisi.

scripts.build: node scripts/sync-voice-assets.mjs && node scripts/build-cli-shim.mjs && vite build && npm run build:server
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win portable --x64 --publish never && node scripts/build-modern-setup.mjs --rebuild-app
scripts.dist:win:appx: npm run build && electron-builder --win appx --x64 --publish never
scripts.test:setup: npx tsx scripts/generate-installer-locales.mjs && dotnet run --project installer/Agendamea.Setup.Tests/Agendamea.Setup.Tests.csproj -c Release
scripts.test: node scripts/sync-voice-assets.mjs && node scripts/build-cli-shim.mjs && tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/unit/*.test.ts tests/integration/*.test.ts tests/automation100.test.ts tests/i18n73.test.ts tests/qaAuditFixes.test.ts
scripts.test:coverage: node scripts/sync-voice-assets.mjs && node scripts/build-cli-shim.mjs && c8 --check-coverage --lines 75 --branches 65 --functions 75 --include="shared/*.cjs" --include="shared/store/*.cjs" --include="shared/schemas/*.cjs" --include="mcp/*.cjs" --include="src/utils/*.ts" --include="src/db/**/*.ts" --include="server/**/*.ts" --exclude="shared/*Locales/**" --exclude="**/*.d.ts" tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/unit/*.test.ts tests/integration/*.test.ts tests/automation100.test.ts tests/i18n73.test.ts tests/qaAuditFixes.test.ts
